CodeCaves should be manually reset before hand. public bool CloseCave() Returns bool CloseCodeCaves() Closes all instances of Detours in the CaveManager. public void CloseCodeCaves() CreateCodeCave(int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>) Creates a new CodeCave, managed by the CodeCave and automatically writes the CodeCave payload. Extra space in memory to allocate to the CodeCave. Extra space may be automatically added to ensure proper alignment for instructions. Custom bytes to write to the CodeCave. public CodeCave? The number of bytes being replaced with a JMP to the Detour. Extra space in memory to allocate to the Detour. Extra space may be automatically added to ensure proper alignment for instructions. Custom bytes to write to the Detour. public Detour? CreateDetour(nint address, int bytesReplaced, int extraSpace, ReadOnlySpan<byte> payload) Parameters address nint bytesReplaced int extraSpace int payload ReadOnlySpan<byte> Returns Detour Dispose() This is the mandatory IDisposable method. api/MemoryBadger.Caves.Detour.html.title: Class Detour | Memory Badger
api/MemoryBadger.Caves.Detour.html.summary: Class Detour Namespace MemoryBadger.Caves Assembly MemoryBadger.dll Class for managing an automated Detour Hook. Inherits from CodeCave and will automatically handle JMP instructions to and from the detour. Does not automatically copy the original bytes to allow flexibility. this should be done manually if required. public class Detour : CodeCave, IDisposable Inheritance object CodeCave Detour Implements IDisposable Inherited Members CodeCave.Address CodeCave.Size CodeCave.EndAddress CodeCave.Payload CodeCave.ExtraSpaceLength CodeCave.IsDisposed CodeCave.Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) CodeCave.Dispose() object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Properties ExtraSpaceAddress The first memory address of extra space after the payload. public override nint ExtraSpaceAddress { get; } Property Value nint OriginalAddress The virtual memory address of the original instruction(s) being replaced. public nint OriginalAddress { get; } Property Value nint OriginalBytes Holds a snapshot of the original code instructions before they were overwritten by the detour. public byte[] OriginalBytes { get; } Property Value byte[] Methods Clear() Overwrites the cave space back to empty instructions (NOPs). Also re-writes the original instructions and resets OriginalAddress and OriginalBytes. public override bool Clear() Returns bool Write(nint, int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>) Writes raw bytes safely into this specific cave allocation and creates a jmp from the original instruction(s) to the cave. public bool Write(nint originalAddress, int bytesReplaced, ReadOnlySpan<byte> payload) Parameters originalAddress nint bytesReplaced int payload ReadOnlySpan<byte> Returns bool

api/MemoryBadger.Memory.html.summary: Class Memory Namespace MemoryBadger Assembly MemoryBadger.dll Holds all memory related methods. public class Memory Inheritance object Memory Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Methods Attach(string) Opens a process. public bool Attach(string processName) Parameters processName string Name of the process to open. Returns bool True if successful. Close() Closes the currently opened process. public bool Close() Returns bool True if successful. CreateCaveManager(nint, int) Allocates an executable memory page in the target process near a preferred address, managed by a CaveManager instance to allow the creation of multiple smaller caves and hooks in a single memory allocation with ease. public CaveManager CreateCaveManager(nint address, int size = 4096) Parameters address nint The preferred baseline address to start searching from. size int The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page. Returns CaveManager A managed CaveManager instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations. Exceptions InvalidOperationException Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching. CreateCodeCave(nint, int) Allocates memory for and creates a CodeCave. Use Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) to write custom instructions. public CodeCave CreateCodeCave(nint address, int size = 4096) Parameters address nint The preferred baseline address to start searching for free memory from. size int The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page. Returns CodeCave A managed CodeCave instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations. Exceptions InvalidOperationException Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching. CreateCodeCave(nint, ReadOnlySpan<byte>, int) Allocates memory for and creates a CodeCave. Automatically writes payload using Write(ReadOnlySpan<byte>) public CodeCave CreateCodeCave(nint address, ReadOnlySpan<byte> payload, int size = 4096) Parameters address nint The preferred baseline address to start searching for free memory from. payload ReadOnlySpan<byte> A ReadOnlySpan<T> containing custom bytes to autoatically write to the CodeCave size int The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page. Returns CodeCave A managed CodeCave instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations. Exceptions InvalidOperationException Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching. CreateDetour(nint, int) Allocates memory for and creates a Detour. Use Write(nint, int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>) to write custom instructions. The Detour automatically writes JMP instructions to and from the Detour after writing your instructions. public Detour CreateDetour(nint address, int size = 4096) Parameters address nint The preferred baseline address to start searching for free memory from. size int The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page. Returns Detour A managed CodeCave instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations. Exceptions InvalidOperationException Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching. CreateDetour(nint, int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>, int) Allocates memory for and creates a Detour. Automatically writes your custom payload to the detour using Write(nint, int, ReadOnlySpan<byte>) The Detour automatically writes JMP instructions to and from the Detour after writing your instructions. public Detour CreateDetour(nint address, int bytesReplaced, ReadOnlySpan<byte> payload, int size = 4096) Parameters address nint The preferred baseline address to start searching for free memory from. bytesReplaced int Number of bytes that will be replaced when writing the the JMP from the original game code to the detour. payload ReadOnlySpan<byte> A ReadOnlySpan<T> containing custom bytes to automatically write in the Detour size int The total size of the parent page to allocate. Defaults to 4096 bytes which is the size of a single page. Returns Detour A managed CodeCave instance capable of spawning safe sub-allocations. Exceptions InvalidOperationException Thrown if Windows fails to allocate memory after searching. GetAddress(nint, ReadOnlySpan<int>) Reads the final address of a multi-level pointer. Example usage: GetAddress(baseAddress + 0x26A, [0x40, 0x08, 0x28]). public nint GetAddress(nint baseAddress, ReadOnlySpan<int> offsets) Parameters baseAddress nint Initial address of the pointer. offsets ReadOnlySpan<int> Array of offsets to be applied to the pointer. Returns nint GetModuleAddressByName(string) Gets the base memory address of a specific module by name. public nint GetModuleAddressByName(string name) Parameters name string Module name (e.g. "gamedll_x64_rwdi.dll"). Returns nint Base memory address of specified module. GetModuleByName(string) Gets a specific module by name. public ProcessModule? GetModuleByName(string name) Parameters name string Module name (e.g. "gamedll_x64_rwdi.dll"). Returns ProcessModule Base memory address of specified module. ReadString(nint, int, Encoding?, bool) Reads a string from a specific memory address. public string ReadString(nint address, int length, Encoding? stringEncoding = null, bool zeroTerminated = true) Parameters address nint The target virtual memory address in the external process. length int The maximum number of bytes to read from memory. stringEncoding Encoding The character encoding type to use. Defaults to UTF8 if null. zeroTerminated bool Whether the string should truncate at the first null-terminator (0x00) found. Returns string The decoded string value read from the target memory address, or an empty string if reading fails. Read<T>(nint) Reads a single, fixed-size value of type T from the specified memory address. public T Read<T>(nint address) where T : unmanaged Parameters address nint The target virtual memory address in the external process. Returns T The value read from the target process memory, or default if the address fails validation or the read operation fails. Type Parameters T The unmanaged value type to read (e.g., int, float, or a custom structural struct). Read<T>(nint, int) Reads a fixed number of elements from the specified memory address and allocates a new array containing the data. public T[] Read<T>(nint address, int length) where T : unmanaged Parameters address nint The target virtual memory address in the external process. length int The total number of elements to read from memory. Returns T[] A newly allocated array containing the elements read from memory; or an empty array if length is zero/negative or the validation fails. Type Parameters T The unmanaged element type of the array. Read<T>(nint, Span<T>) Reads memory from the specified address directly into an existing, pre-allocated buffer or span without causing heap allocations. public bool Read<T>(nint address, Span<T> buffer) where T : unmanaged Parameters address nint The target virtual memory address in the external process. buffer Span<T> The destination span where the retrieved memory bytes will be directly written. Returns bool true if the memory was successfully read and copied into the buffer; otherwise, false. Type Parameters T The unmanaged element type of the destination buffer. ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<char>, nint) Scans for an array of bytes, returning a list of results. To avoid bad results, try to make the array of bytes as unique as possible. public nint ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<char> signature, nint startAddress = 0) Parameters signature ReadOnlySpan<char> Bytes to scan for for passed in a string. ?? and ? are treated as wildcards. Example: "48 8B ?? ?? 48" startAddress nint Base address of memory module to start scan from. Returns nint List contining address found matching provided byte signature. If the scan was good, it is usually the first address. ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<byte?>, nint) Scans for an array of bytes, returning a list of results. To avoid bad results, try to make the array of bytes as unique as possible. public nint ScanMemory(ReadOnlySpan<byte?> signature, nint startAddress = 0) Parameters signature ReadOnlySpan<byte?> Bytes to scan for for passed in a ReadOnlySpan<T>. Null bytes are treated as wildcards. Example: [0x48, 0x8B, null, null, 0x48] startAddress nint Base address of memory module to start scan from. Returns nint List contining address found matching provided byte signature. If the scan was good, it is usually the first address. WriteString(nint, string, Encoding?) Writes a string to a specific memory address and appends a null-terminator. public bool WriteString(nint address, string value, Encoding? encoding = null) Parameters address nint The target virtual memory address in the external process. value string The string value to write into the target process. encoding Encoding The character encoding type to use. Defaults to UTF8 if null. Returns bool true if the string and its null-terminator were successfully written; otherwise, false. Write<T>(nint, ReadOnlySpan<T>) Writes a sequence of elements from a read-only buffer to the specified memory address. public bool Write<T>(nint address, ReadOnlySpan<T> buffer) where T : unmanaged Parameters address nint The target virtual memory address in the external process. buffer ReadOnlySpan<T> The read-only data span to write. Natively accepts arrays, array slices, and stack-allocated blocks. Returns bool true if the buffer contents were successfully written to the target process; otherwise, false. Type Parameters T The unmanaged element type of the buffer data. Write<T>(nint, T) Writes a single, fixed-size value of type T to the specified memory address. public bool Write<T>(nint address, T value) where T : unmanaged Parameters address nint The target virtual memory address in the external process. value T The data value to write into the target process memory space. Returns bool true if the value was successfully written; otherwise, false. Type Parameters T The unmanaged value type to write (e.g., int, float, or a custom structural struct).
